title: tiny-secp256k1: Stale buffer after ignored wasm failure accepts invalid infinity tweak (CVE-2026-107853)
description: A vulnerability in tiny-secp256k1 versions >=2.1.0 <2.2.5 and >=2.2.2 <2.2.5 allows an invalid tweak operation to be accepted due to a stale buffer comparison after a wasm failure. Specifically, the three-argument form of xOnlyPointAddTweakCheck ignores the wasm failure return and compares an unchanged input buffer, causing it to incorrectly validate an invalid derivation when the tweak results in the point at infinity. This flaw is fixed in version 2.2.5.
